description:
Job Duties 
 Platform Development 
 Design, build, and maintain both the  frontend and backend  of a new internal AI-powered platform — taking ownership of features from development through production deployment
 Build and maintain  integrations  between the platform and cloud services, AI APIs, and internal data sources
 Write clean, tested, and well-documented code across the full stack ( Python backend + React/TypeScript frontend )
 Contribute to  architectural discussions  with guidance from senior engineers — learning to think beyond the feature and consider system design
 AI & Automation 
 Integrate  generative AI and LLM capabilities  into the platform to help business teams find information faster, answer questions, and automate repetitive workflows
 Begin applying  agentic and tool-calling patterns  with growing independence — supported by senior engineers
 Collaboration & Requirements 
 Partner with  business teams  to understand workflows and translate them into working software features — with some guidance on scoping and prioritization
 Participate actively in  design reviews, sprint planning, and retrospectives 
 Communicate progress, blockers, and tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Security & Governance 
 Implement  secure authentication and access control  (OAuth 2.0 / OIDC) appropriate for sensitive business data
 Follow and contribute to  data governance practices  to ensure the platform handles information responsibly
 Engineering Practices 
 Contribute to and follow team  engineering best practices  — unit testing, integration testing, code reviews, and documentation
 Work confidently within  CI/CD pipelines  to build, test, and deploy features to production
 Use  observability and monitoring tools  to diagnose issues and understand platform health in production
 Iteration & Improvement 
 Gather and act on  real user feedback  to iterate on features over time
 Balance  speed and reliability  — shipping incrementally while maintaining production quality standards
 
 Level:   Level:  Junior / Early-Career (1–2 years of professional experience)
 Education 
 Bachelor's degree in  Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems , or a related technical field
 Relevant coursework or self-study in: Web Development, Cloud Computing, Databases, Software Engineering, or AI/ML
 Equivalent practical experience considered in lieu of degree
 Technical Skills 
 Languages & Frameworks 
 1–2 years of hands-on Python experience  — professional or project-based; exposure to FastAPI or a comparable async framework is a plus
 React + TypeScript  — has shipped or contributed to UI features in a real or production-like environment
 Solid understanding of  REST API design  and client-server architecture
 Cloud & Infrastructure 
 Working experience with at least one major cloud provider ( Azure preferred; AWS or GCP considered ) — has deployed or managed cloud resources in a real project
 Hands-on experience with  Docker and containerized deployments 
 Active experience working within  CI/CD pipelines  (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar)
 AI / Generative AI 
 Has worked with  LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, or similar) in at least one project — professional, personal, or academic
 Growing familiarity with  agentic patterns and tool-calling  is a strong differentiator
 Security & Auth 
 Working knowledge of  OAuth 2.0 / OIDC  authentication flows — has implemented or debugged auth in a real application
 Awareness of secure coding practices and data privacy principles
 Soft Skills & Work Style 
 Can  work with non-technical stakeholders  to clarify requirements — asks the right questions and translates feedback into actionable tasks
 Takes  end-to-end ownership  of features — doesn't need hand-holding to get from ticket to production
 Comfortable  iterating in ambiguity  — can make reasonable decisions and know when to escalate
 Values  code quality, testing, and documentation  as part of the job, not an afterthought
 Eager to  grow toward senior-level independence  — proactively seeks feedback and applies it
 What You'll Grow Into 
 This role is a launchpad toward  senior engineering responsibilities . You'll take on meaningful scope from day one — owning features end-to-end — while being mentored on system design, architectural thinking, and cross-functional leadership.

 
 Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19.  Details can vary by role.
 Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.
 Mandatory Notices 
 U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer:  In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.
 Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).  
 For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. 
 We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.
 Preference will be given to qualified candidates who do not reside, or plan to reside, in Alabama, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Indiana, Iowa, Louisiana, Maryland, Mississippi, Missouri, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, or Tennessee.
 This position may be filled at a different job level than listed here depending on

business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.

Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the

candidate’s qualifications, consistent with applicable law.
 Accommodation & Accessibility Notice:
 Intuitive is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact People Services at HRHelpNow@intusurg.com.
 We provide market-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors, including experience, skills, and qualifications. The target compensation ranges are listed.
